Overview

Shymkent is a city in Shymkent with a population of 1,100,000. Kazakhstan’s third-largest city in the south, a major industrial and cultural center near the Uzbek border. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.0.
